internal_carrier: LibraryIntent + library_job_intent keyed by existing job.id; no canonical Job field/enum change
progress: progress_done=terminal_count/progress_total=fixed total; scan discovery uses0/0 until a manifest is sealed; discovered count is separately visible and is not whole-directory completeness
result_ref: Library parent canonical Job.result_ref=null; use LibraryTask.accounting_ref and typed result routes, not /model-runs on a library ID
resource_state: CPU-only scan/file operation released (no GPU acquired); description parent projects actual current child GPU state; unknown remains unknown

legacy_routes.GET /api/v1/jobs: include library parents as canonical batch with no new fields; same ID; scope-filtered as before
legacy_routes.GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}: canonical projection only; no needs_attention/reconciling leakage
legacy_routes.POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/cancel: dispatcher resolves LibraryIntent to correct domain owner; existing analyze scope alone cannot control a file operation, initiating local session or explicit operation-control permission required
legacy_routes.POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/retry: library parents rejected409 LIBRARY_RETRY_REQUIRES_REVIEW; no disk/provider replay
legacy_routes.POST /api/v1/jobs/batch: request body and legacy behavior unchanged, cannot create arbitrary LibraryIntent

new_cancel: Library task/file-operation cancel delegates to same domain owner and original scope/custody; records cancellation and accounts in-flight authorized effects
resume: file operation reconciliation first proves prior writer exit; no forced lease takeover; explicit review/confirmation for new side effects
